captions.instagram:
Reception desk for an office in Brentwood.

The whole desk was marked out in tape on the carpet first, so every unit had a line to follow. Then plinths, carcasses, the L-shaped top, a raised counter with an angled end, and vertical slats along the front.

Swipe from bare MDF to finished.
